admission.justification: Rail retention, message switching, counted loads and burst coalescing live in different files across shell, frame component, controller and chat panel; no member alone promises the one-loaded-chat lifetime, so the guarantee needs the joint reading.

guarantee: The shell keeps one DocumentChat and frame across Operations, task documents and the review page, hiding it without unloading or reparenting so draft and scroll survive. Operations retains first-show creation when no preload is requested; a review may preload the closed column with an agentless Paseo client, creating no agent, then open its bound existing task chat when shown and the channel is ready. Hidden wrappers stay out of keyboard and accessibility reach. Existing known-no-agent and unknown-discovery presentations, ready-channel message steering, qualified recovery and one-generation-per-document-load rules remain distinct; late responsive answers do not reload, and unavailable nonloading selection bursts coalesce to the latest target.
title: One loaded sidebar chat switches by message and hides without unloading
